external.note: GBIF usageKey 2464291 and iNaturalist taxon 37541 matched species rank on 2026-10-31. ITIS TSN 1182774 is the valid record for this name; Wikidata P685 gives TSN 96757, a different ITIS record, so it is not used.

conservation.note: Wikidata P141 = least concern (Q211005). Not checked against the IUCN Red List directly.

range.note: Country list from the Wikipedia distribution line (S China, Bhutan, Taiwan, Thailand, Vietnam, India, W Malaysia) plus Vietnam from the review. Bangladesh and the Nepal, Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos records found in other sources are NOT included: none is backed by a licensed source checked here. Native status is not checked against introduced-range evidence.

traits.body_plan.note: Reptile (Vertebrate); no sentence in the sources restates it.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Walking follows from the well-developed pentadactyl limbs; no gait observation is in the sources.

traits.thermoregulation.note: Authored from reptile class; no source line checked.

traits.metamorphosis.note: Authored: no larval stage in a lizard.

traits.nest_type.note: Authored as None. Live-bearing reproduction (not cited here: licence of the 1996 Zoological Studies source not verified) would mean no nest; confirm before merge.

traits.perching.note: Specimens taken under leaf litter and among rocks; perching is not reported.

traits.diet.note: Authored allocation: invertebrate-only. No open source checked gives a diet composition for this species; a non-licensed diet note was found and not used. Needs a licensed diet source.

traits.social.note: Authored as solitary, the usual skink pattern. No source checked states it.

traits.activity_pattern.note: Specimens collected 'at night and in daytime'. Cathemeral is the closest enum value; the shared program can express only diurnal or nocturnal rest.

traits.defense.note: Authored judgement: flight to cover. No source describes the threat response.

habitat.use.note: All records are under leaf litter or among rocks on the ground.

habitat.resources.note: Invertebrate predation follows the authored diet; leaf-litter shelter follows the record note above.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: Authored Avoider: records are from forest, including disturbed forest and hills near a settlement, so the Adapter label is also possible.

seasonal.strategy.note: Authored as active year-round. No open source checked gives a seasonal pattern for this species.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Adult only; no stage durations given.

vocalizations.note: No vocalisation is described in the sources checked. Empty means silent by default, not confirmed silent.

look.note: Colour from the Wikipedia description (brown or olive above, dark brown sides, whitish below). Proportions are authored; the palette values are approximations of that text.

look.proportions.tail_ratio.note: Wikipedia: tail almost twice as long as head and body.

behavior.note: Authored parameters for the shared ground-forager program. Flee and calm distances are judgement. The rest window is the diurnal setting because the species is cathemeral: it is active both day and night, and the program cannot express that.

activity.TW.note: GBIF-only curve (CC0 and CC BY records, country TW, month-bearing, no geospatial issue). The iNaturalist TW histogram under CC0/CC BY gives 221 records, below the 300 threshold, so it was not used. Widening to iNaturalist NC licences would have raised the total to 2421; that NC source was rejected and is not in the record. Taiwan has no iNaturalist admin_level-0 place for the fetcher's name, so the iNaturalist step was skipped automatically.
